text: いい　ポケモンが　けいひんに　あったからよー　がんばってるんだが　ぜんぜん　だめだ！

structure.jp: いい　ポケモンが　けいひんに　あったからよー
structure.en: because there was a good Pokémon among the prizes

patterns.name: 〜から
patterns.explanation: から after a verb gives the reason for what comes next. あったから = 'because there was one'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on now; here it is shortened to てる, as in casual speech. がんばってる = 'I've been trying hard'.

patterns.name: 〜のだが
patterns.explanation: んだ adds a tone of explaining your situation, and が after it means 'but'. がんばってるんだが = 'I've been trying hard, but'.
